notes.title: Game Update [0.6.02.0116]
notes.content: [p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed spaceship close button label from [b]"Cancel"[/b] to [b]"Close"[/b] after making ship inventory persistent[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed action tooltip not appearing in the actions menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain buildings opening the wrong menu when clicked[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mouse click indicator icon not appearing in the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed astronaut positioning inside buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed construction grid being visible during cutscenes in certain situations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a minor clicking issue when demolishing corridors[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed action tooltip not appearing in the actions menu
- Fixed certain buildings opening the wrong menu when clicked
- Fixed mouse click indicator icon not appearing in the tutorial
- Fixed construction grid being visible during cutscenes in certain situations
- Fixed a minor clicking issue when demolishing corridors
